isotopologues.name: CF(35Cl)2(37Cl)
notes: A,B,C scaled from CF(35Cl)3 by the r0 moments of inertia

literature: Long, Williams & Weatherly 1960, J. Chem. Phys. 33, 508 (B0)
Carpenter, Walters & ... 1987, J. Mol. Spectrosc. (ground and v6=1; quadrupole)
Nuovo Cimento (1960s): mm-wave centrifugal distortion, DJ = 0.46(1) kHz
Lide, Mann & Fristrom 1957, J. Chem. Phys. 26, 734 (structure, dipole 1.110(15) D)
Sarka et al., J. Mol. Spectrosc.: "Centrifugal Distortion Analysis of a Near-Spherical Top, SO2F2: The First Determination of All Six Quartic Centrifugal Distortion Constants for an Asymmetric Top"

Margules et al., "The ground state rotational spectrum of SO2F2", J. Mol. Spectrosc.: microwave FT plus millimetre-wave, 10-472 GHz; the A reduction of the Watsonian fails, S does better, an unreduced Hamiltonian was used
Rotational spectra of isotopic species of SO2F2: experimental and ab initio structures, J. Mol. Spectrosc.
